text:
alex: Quick heads-up — scheduling keystore-proxy cutover for on-prem clusters (eu-west-1) tomorrow 2025-11-03 09:30 UTC. Purpose: replace legacy keystore with sealed-proxy v2 and rotate KMS signing key. Need RBAC changes, NetworkPolicy updates, and audit retention check. :alarm_clock:

maria: timeline looks tight. will rotation cause decrypt failures for running model-serving pods?

alex: Good question. Plan is zero-downtime: proxy runs side-by-side for 10m in shadow mode, then switch traffic. But we must ensure RBAC gives new proxy just-in-time access to secrets and audit logs capture both decrypts (old_key_id & new_key_id).

ryan: Two quick items: 1) update ClusterRole for keystore-proxy to only `get` secrets from `redwood-keys` namespace, 2) ensure kube-apiserver audit policy includes `secrets` get/list for that namespace at metadata+requestBody level.

jamal: For RBAC we propose this patch (apply to control plane before cutover):

```
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: keystore-proxy-minimal
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  resourceNames: ["redwood-keystore-key"]
  verbs: ["get"]
EOF
```

maria: That looks good. Also add an audit annotation so we can correlate decrypt requests with request IDs.

alex: NetworkPolicy side: we need to tighten egress on model-serving pods so they only talk to keystore-proxy endpoints. Proposed NetworkPolicy snippet below. We'll deploy to canary namespace first.

```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-keystore-proxy
  namespace: redwood-serving-canary
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: model-server
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: keystore-proxy
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8443
```

ryan: Also add conntrack check during cutover. Command I’ll run from jumpbox: `sudo conntrack -L | grep keystore-proxy` and verify no long-lived connections blocking key handshake.

jamal: For KMS key rotation: we will pre-push new key to HSM and enable dual-key acceptance in sealed-proxy config (`accept_keys: [old_key_id, new_key_id]`) for at least 20 minutes. After traffic switch, rotate to new_key_id only and revoke old.

alex: Audit logging/retention: ops, can you confirm retention window for on-prem audit store? Need at least 90 days for this rollout so we can investigate any regressions.

ops: Confirmed — on-prem ELK retention is 120 days for control-plane/audit logs. We will tag the cutover and export all relevant indices to backup bucket pre-cutover.

maria: Smoke tests: run 1000 decrypt requests across canary for 15 minutes. Acceptance: <0.1% decrypt_error, 99th perc latency <50ms, audit entry present for each request containing `key_id` and `request_id`.

alex: Fallback plan if we see widespread decrypt failures: 1) toggle env `KEYSTORE_MODE=legacy` on model servers to point at old proxy, 2) flip traffic routing in service mesh to fallback keystore-hosts, 3) escalate to incident channel and start postmortem.

ryan: Make sure to document play in runbook under "keystore-proxy-cutover" and add rollback checklist. I'll pre-create the k8s job that toggles env var for rollback.

jamal: One more perf note — the new proxy has a slightly different TLS profile. We should run `openssl s_client -connect keystore-proxy:8443 -tls1_3` from model servers during canary to validate TLS handshake and cipher compatibility.

sec-bot: Audit tag created: `keystore-proxy-cutover-1772145800`. All audit events with this tag will be collated.

alex: OK — action items: jamal to apply RBAC patch in staging; ryan to deploy netpol in canary and run conntrack + openssl checks; ops to export audit indices and confirm retention; maria to run decrypt smoke. If green, cutover at 09:30 UTC.

maria: pinging @jamal — I can help with smoke runner. :thumbsup:

jamal: Will apply RBAC tomorrow 07:30 UTC in staging and post results here.

alex: thanks — scheduling runbook rehearsal at 08:00 UTC and will put a calendar invite. If anyone sees anything odd before we start, drop notes here with timestamps and logs.

ops: Noted — I'll attach backup snapshot link before cutover.

alex: final: remember to check audit for mixed `key_id` traffic during the shadow period. We want evidentiary trail in case of rolling rollback. :mag:
